commit.message:
fix: block IPv4-mapped IPv6 loopback bypass in SSRF guard (GHSA-pvrj-8cg3-j5f8)

The WHATWG URL parser hex-normalizes IPv4-mapped IPv6 addresses, so
http://[::ffff:127.0.0.1] becomes http://[::ffff:7f00:1] before reaching
isPrivateV6(). The existing guard only handled the dotted-decimal form
(net.isIPv4("7f00:1") is false), so the hex form fell through and
loopback / private-range addresses bypassed assertSafeUrl().

Parse the two trailing hex groups back into an IPv4 address and run it
through isPrivateV4(). Verified against 127.0.0.1, 10.x, 192.168.x,
169.254.169.254 in both dotted and hex forms; public IPv4-mapped
addresses (e.g. ::ffff:0808:0808 for 8.8.8.8) still pass.
